qualification: Issuer-sourced conversion entitlements; registration, successor tradability, actual account allocations and tax/other corporate actions require separate evidence before a full corrected portfolio replay.
publication_time_policy: Only announcement dates were verified; known_at is conservatively the start of the following local calendar day, not an assertion of exact publication time.
fraction_policy: Do not round an individual account by guess: the notices allocate whole shares across holders by remainder ranking, with random allocation for equal remainders.
